keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 1, Columbus Crew 0. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire FC) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Noah Allen (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 1, Columbus Crew 1. Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Taha Habroune.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 2, Columbus Crew 1. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire FC) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 2, Columbus Crew 2. Anass Zaroury (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Mbekezeli Mbokazi (Chicago Fire FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 2. Maren Haile-Selassie (Chicago Fire FC) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
First Half ends, Chicago Fire FC 3, Columbus Crew 2.
